entry_root_min_height.meaning: entry route reserves full viewport shell

welcome_surface.meaning: relative, isolated, overflow-hidden full-viewport entry surface

welcome_content_layer.meaning: existing interactive welcome content is z-index 2

route_dispatch.meaning: common route dispatcher calls renderWelcome for /welcome

route_dispose_boundary.meaning: route changes close overlays, re-render root and restore route focus

focus_contract.meaning: existing route transition focus targets first heading/root

future_mount_contract.placement: first child of #root > .welcome-page, sibling of welcome visual/copy layers
future_mount_contract.pointer_policy: visual canvas pointer-events:none; any skip/continue control is normal DOM outside canvas
future_mount_contract.global_z_index_rule: do not use global overlay bands >=50; entry motion stays inside welcome stacking context
future_mount_contract.overflow_rule: rely on .welcome-page overflow:hidden; do not change body/root overflow for motion
future_mount_contract.layout_reservation: welcome-page/root retain full-viewport min-height before/during/after motion to avoid layout jump
future_mount_contract.resize_rule: renderer receives host CSS-pixel width/height and updates camera aspect only; fixed lens/FOV remains invariant
future_mount_contract.dpr_rule: adapter may cap render DPR for performance; DPR is rendering quality, never a geometry/scale mechanic
future_mount_contract.shell_dependency: must not query or position from .welcome-shell, .r6-welcome-grid or Candidate A/C DOM

adapter_interface.name: StudyGridMotionEntryAdapter

constructor_config.motionProfileId: opaque approved profile id; shell does not branch on A/C

methods.mount: allocate renderer/assets/listeners without navigating or stealing focus
methods.start: start full sequence only when allowed; must be idempotent
methods.skip: transition to shell-ready state immediately and safely
methods.dispose: cancel loads/RAF/listeners and release renderer resources
methods.replaceAssetManifest: swap approved G/3x3 asset/version without changing shell DOM contract

adapter_interface.handoff_rule: HANDOFF_READY reveals/enables the existing welcome shell; it does not auto-navigate. Existing welcome controls remain the authority for /start, /tour and sign-in.

fields.gAssetUri: approved canonical-G-derived asset pointer when available
fields.gridAssetUri: approved nine-cube/final-grid asset pointer when available
fields.handoffMarker: named motion marker used for HTML handoff timing

asset_manifest_contract.swap_guarantee: changing canonical G or final 3x3 asset is manifest-level; no welcome/root shell rewrite required

r5_r6_differences.R6: late renderWelcome override widens shell to min(1120px,calc(100% - 32px)) and adds .r6-welcome-grid/.r6-welcome-panel
r5_r6_differences.integration_effect: motion host cannot use welcome-shell geometry as camera/mount geometry

r5_r6_differences.R6: .r6-welcome-grid collapses to one column at max-width 900px; additional mobile rules at 620px
r5_r6_differences.integration_effect: host must bind to .welcome-page bounds, not content column count

r5_r6_differences.R6: original function remains plus late assignment override
r5_r6_differences.integration_effect: do not monkey-patch a specific renderWelcome body; future integration should use one common post-render sync hook

r5_r6_differences.R6: adds instructor-first welcome/workspace and related overrides
r5_r6_differences.integration_effect: shell handoff must preserve whichever baseline General later authorizes; Q-B9 does not choose

future_insertion_point.preferred_hook: one explicit syncMotionEntry(route) call after route-specific render inside common render()
future_insertion_point.why: common across R5/R6, allows mount on /welcome and dispose on every other route, avoids duplicate R6 renderWelcome bodies

integration_blockers.detail: General must later choose the authorized HTML integration baseline because R5 is accepted while R6 remains unpromoted.
Candidate A/C selection and final approved motion package/asset manifest are intentionally absent.
canonical G/final 3x3 asset identity must be supplied later; adapter contract already isolates this as manifest data.

forbidden: gate product entry on animation completion
animate camera lens/FOV in fixed-lens path
capture global keyboard focus in canvas
